response.sql:
WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN observatories AS o
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
phase_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS mean_phase_avg
  FROM phase_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(p.avg_bandusage) AS avg_of_phase_averages,
  SUM(p.telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count,
  AVG(p.avg_bandusage - m.mean_phase_avg) AS avg_excess_over_mean
FROM phase_stats AS p
CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m
WHERE p.avg_bandusage > m.mean_phase_avg;

assumptions.assumption: Each telescope counts toward its phase count even when its bandwidth usage is missing; AVG ignores missing bandwidth values, and phases with no nonmissing bandwidth have no average and cannot qualify.
